risks.risk: Hydraulic cylinder may leak or fail to hold a load over time.
risks.proof: A video showing the truck lifting a 1000kg+ load and holding it for 10 minutes without dropping.
risks.if_unproven: as having a faulty hydraulic pump or leaking seals.

risks.risk: Scissor arms or pivot points may be bent or cracked under the paint.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all pivot joints and the underside of the scissor arms.
risks.if_unproven: as having structural fatigue or wear.

risks.risk: Wheel bearings may be seized or wheels may have flat spots.
risks.proof: A video of the truck being pushed and pulled across a flat floor.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a full set of replacement wheels and bearings.

proof_requests: Video of the hydraulic system lifting a heavy load to full height and holding it.
Photo of the manufacturer's metal identification plate showing the model and serial number.
Video of the truck being moved to check wheel and bearing condition.
Close-up photos of the hydraulic cylinder base to check for oil leaks.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a 1500kg capacity high-lift pallet truck. While the brand is unknown, it can be priced as a generic used unit with unverified hydraulics.
